title: Latent Algorithmic Structure Precedes Grokking: A Mechanistic Study of ReLU MLPs on Modular Arithmetic
abstract: arXiv:2603.23784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grokking-the phenomenon where validation accuracy of neural networks on modular addition of two integers rises long after training data has been memorized-has been characterized in previous works as producing sinusoidal input weight distributions in transformers and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs). We find empirically that ReLU MLPs in our experimental setting instead learn near-binary square wave input weights, where intermediate-valued weights appear exclusively near sign-change boundaries, alongside output weight distributions whose dominant Fourier phases satisfy a phase-sum relation $\phi_{\mathrm{out}} = \phi_a + \phi_b$; this relation holds even when the model is trained on noisy data and fails to grok. We extract the frequency and phase of each neuron's weights via DFT and construct an idealized MLP: Input weights are replaced by perfect binary square waves and output weights by cosines, both parametrized by the frequencies, pha

translated_title: 潜在算法结构先于Grokking出现：对ReLU多层感知机在模运算上的机制研究
translated_abstract: Grokking（即神经网络在两个整数模加法任务上的验证准确率在训练数据早已被记忆之后很久才突然上升的现象）在以往工作中被描述为会在Transformer和多层感知机（MLP）中产生正弦形的输入权重分布。我们在实验中发现，在我们的实验设置下，ReLU MLP反而学习到接近二值的方波输入权重，其中间取值的权重仅出现在符号翻转边界附近；同时其输出权重分布的主导傅里叶相位满足相位和关系 φ_out = φ_a + φ_b，而且即使模型在含噪数据上训练、未能发生grokking时，该关系依然成立。我们通过离散傅里叶变换（DFT）提取每个神经元权重的频率与相位，并据此构建了一个理想化的MLP：输入权重被替换为完美的二值方波，输出权重被替换为余弦函数，二者均由频率、相位等参数刻画
tldr: 本研究通过对ReLU MLP权重的傅里叶分析发现，在模加法任务中，近二值方波输入权重及满足 φ_out = φ_a + φ_b 的输出相位关系这一潜在算法结构在grokking发生之前就已形成，且该结构在模型未能grokking时依然存在，作者据此构建理想化MLP验证了这一机制。
en_tdlr: This mechanistic study shows that a latent algorithmic structure—near-binary square-wave input weights and output phases satisfying φ_out = φ_a + φ_b—precedes grokking in ReLU MLPs on modular arithmetic, persists even when the model fails to grok, and is validated through an idealized MLP constructed from DFT-extracted frequencies and phases.
